question: What realization of creation, maintenance, and dissolution reveals the fourth state?
premises: The whole world arises from the self in manifold difference.
When dissolved in the self, no separate other remains.
One may see creation, maintenance, and dissolution as play within a partless reality.
inference: Seeing the world's arising and dissolution as play in the partless self reveals the fourth state.
uncertainties: padabhitaḥ is slightly unusual; taken here as 'from the standpoint of the state/pada'.
plain_english: The whole world arises from me in many differentiated forms, yet when it dissolves in me no other remains. One who sees creation, maintenance, and dissolution as play in a partless reality shines forth in the fourth state.
